rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: k = Ae^(−Ea/RT); log(k2/k1) = Ea(T2−T1)/(2.303R·T1T2) — the two-temperature form is the numerical workhorse; R = 8.314 J.  ·  Trick 2: Graph marks: ln k vs 1/T is a straight line with slope −Ea/R and intercept ln A — draw and label axes.
